decisions.reason: It clearly builds on the firm’s core tariff and market-data capabilities, remained prominently marketed with its own page in 2024, and therefore fits the firm’s absorptive capacity and platform strategy well.

Although its reduced website prominence suggests weaker standalone momentum, it is still close to the firm’s established knowledge base and can likely be retained as an integrated feature that the firm can refine through its own R&D and customer learning.

This tool builds on the firm’s existing regional data, process knowledge and integration strengths, and despite being only mentioned in 2024 it remains complementary to the central platform rather than outside the firm’s competence base.
